A useful little guide

How to use voice recorder

Record microphone audio locally with playback and a downloadable file. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

  1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
  2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
  3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

A detail to keep in mind

Recording formats depend on the browser. Audio stays in this page session, and microphone tracks are stopped when you stop or leave.

Questions, answered.

Is voice recorder free to use?

Yes. This tool is part of Nepocore’s free browser toolkit. There is no paid tier, file-download gate or application account required.

What should I check before using the result?

Recording formats depend on the browser. Audio stays in this page session, and microphone tracks are stopped when you stop or leave.

Does this tool upload my files or text?

The tool processes its input in your browser. File contents and text are not sent to a processing server. See the privacy page for local storage and hosting details.
